string.RemovingDependencyLinksKeepsPackagesInst: 종속성 연결을 제거해도 패키지, 프로세스 설정 및 활성 실행은 유지됩니다.
string.MigrationRequired: This change requires migration or additional support
string.ProcessChangesAffectActiveExecutions: Process changes can affect active executions
string.UnresolvedPackageDependencies: Local deletions break package dependencies. Restore the required definitions from the package version.
string.ContactEmailVisible: This email will be visible in the catalog. It does not determine package ownership.
string.MarketplaceNotConfigured: The Marketplace service is not configured. File installation and updates remain available.
string.NoNewVersion: This installation already uses the latest published version.
string.PublishPackageDescription: Public packages are available to all registered users in this installation. The owner controls access to private packages.
string.PrivatePackageDescription: Available to the owner and selected accounts across their workspaces. This applies to all versions.
string.NoPackageReaders: 아직 액세스 권한이 부여된 계정이 없습니다.
string.PackageReadersDescription: These accounts can view and install every version of a private package. They cannot publish releases or manage access. Removing access does not remove downloaded files or installed definitions. Public packages remain visible to all registered accounts.
string.TransferPackageOwnershipDescription: The new owner can publish releases and manage access. You will lose these rights and private catalog access unless it is granted again. The original author, package identity and existing releases are preserved. The contact email will be cleared.
string.ConfirmPackageOwnershipTransfer: I understand that I will lose ownership
string.CatalogDescription: Card types and processes, ready to install in your workspace.
string.NoInstalledPackages: No packages installed yet. Install a package from the catalog or choose a package file.
string.NoPublishedPackages: No published packages yet. Create a package from a card type or process, or publish an exported file.
string.NoPackageDrafts: No package drafts yet. Ask your connected AI assistant to prepare and save a draft.
string.PackageDraftsDescription: Drafts from your connected AI assistant are stored privately. Review the definition and test its behavior before publication. AI usage is billed by your AI provider.
string.InstallationRequiresMaintainer: A workspace maintainer must review and install this package. Download the file to share it.
string.NoDefinitionChanges: No definition changes. Only the installed package version will change.
string.PackageUpdateExplanation: New fields and independent changes are applied automatically. Only incompatible changes require a choice.
string.ConflictExplanation: The same property was changed differently locally and in the package. Choose the values to keep. Independent changes are merged automatically.
